verdict.rationale: The evidence only partly covers what skills can execute. Skills may bundle executable scripts (scripts/ directory), and on the API they run in the code execution environment. Operators can also control invocation through frontmatter, the disableBundledSkills setting, and SDK controls over which skills Claude can invoke. Nothing in the pack documents a trust model or vetting for third-party or marketplace skills, nor any telemetry or data-collection disclosure for skills. missing for 10: a documented security/trust model for third-party skills and marketplaces, a telemetry/data-collection disclosure, an explicit sandboxing/permission description for skill scripts, and independent corroboration.
